description: Freeman PE20VFS16 20 Volt Cordless 16-Gauge 1" Fencing Stapler Kit with Lithium Ion Battery, Charger, and Bag – 1300 Shots per Charge - Distributed/Packaged by Freeman. Product Details: The Freeman PE20VFS16 20 Volt Cordless 16-Gauge 1" Fencing Stapler Kit with Lithium Ion Battery, Charger, and Bag can drive up to 1300 fasteners per charge and 90 pieces per minute, and is powered by a high-capacity rechargeable 20 volt 2.0 Ah lithium-ion battery. The cordless electric design eliminates the need to be tethered to a loud and heavy air compressor, improving mobility around the house, ranch, farm, or jobsite. This staple gun is ideal for mesh and woven applications such as electrified single wire with insulation, vineyard trellising, snow control fencing, pet enclosures, and livestock fencing. Use the select fire button to toggle fast and easy between single sequential firing for precision or bump firing for speed. The depth of the fencing staples is adjusted by simply turning a wheel near the drive blade, and a quick jam release provides easy access clearing in the event of a jammed fastener. A wire alignment notch ensures accurate fastener placement for DIYers as well as construction contractors. This cordless fencing stapler comes with everything you need to get right to work, including a 20 volt 2.0 Ah lithium-ion battery, rapid charger, canvas bag, and belt hook. The 20 Volt Cordless 16-Gauge 1" Fencing Stapler Kit will significantly increase your mobility and productivity when tackling home improvement and repair projects, and is covered by Freeman's 1 Year Professional Tool Warranty.
